title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1236: Back in time (2)

section.p: Suddenly, a human Invincible roared, “Everyone, start your dao affirmation! Keep them busy and do your best to survive! If they leave you alone, humanity will gain additional Invincibles. You can return to kill them all after your dao affirmation. If they do set their eyes on you, run and pray you’re lucky. We won’t let this rest before killing Liu Jin!”
With that, the group of human Invincibles abandoned their charges and rushed toward Great Han King.

With Great Han King, Great Zhou King, and Junior Zhou King all exerting their influence on the same River of Time, it grew wider and wider. With a calm and cold expression, Great Han King said, “If we keep this up, this will widen enough for the myriad race Eternals to enter together. Have you considered the consequences of letting all these Eternals into the Human Realm?”
That reminded some of the surrounding myriad race Invincibles as their eyes started flickering in anticipation. That was not something they had considered, but it was true.

Great Zhou King’s expression changed as he bellowed furiously, “Are you going to consort with the myriad races? You dare? It’s fine if you decide to give up on humanity, but if you dare to consort with the myriad races against humanity, I won’t rest until I see you dead!”

More and more Invincibles were converging around them while the Pseudo Invincibles on the verge of dao affirmation had unsightly expressions. They scattered in all directions as they all started looking for a suitable place for dao affirmation.
Everything was in a mess.
Xia Longwu, who was in the midst of fleeing, gnashed his teeth and roared, “I’ll be affirming my dao! Myriad races, kill me if you can!”
A divine Invincible shouted, “Give up on the others and focus on Xia Longwu! Kill him! The rest of you, go and help Great Han King!”
“Sever Zhu Tianfang’s River of Time!”
With a rough plan drawn, the myriad race Invincibles ignored everything else and started converging in three locations. The first was Xia Longwu’s location.
The second was Great Zhou King’s location.
The third was the location of Zhu Tianfang’s River of Time.

Meanwhile, Liu Wushen and the others were completely ignored even as they continued their dao affirmations. Or to be precise, only a token number of people, who were also weaker than the Invincibles initially tasked to interfere with these dao affirmations, were left to deal with them.
As chaotic battles were breaking out everywhere, a loud howl resounded all over the Allheaven Battlefield. Multicolored rays of light seemed to have replaced the sky of the Allheaven Battlefields.

Then, Liu Wusheng’s voice rang out, tinged with madness and desperation, “I succeede! Father! Must you insist? Must you betray us? What should the millions upon millions of people in Great Han do about your betrayal? Father, what should I do? Am I supposed to follow in your footsteps and betray humanity as well?”
His aura surged, growing more and more intense as his breakthrough neared completion. He continued flying toward Great Han King while roaring in fury, “Father! You can’t do this!”

With a snort, Great Han King, stomped forth yet again, creating more cracks on the River of Time as he asked coldly, “Must you stop me? As I said, I’m not betraying humanity. I’m only doing this to preserve peace. The multiple character faction must fall for that.”

“You can punish me as you wish for the lives I took and the lives I’m about to take. I can even kill a few myriad race Invincibles and die with them as the punishment. I don’t wish to betray humanity. I’m doing this for humanity!”
He raised his voice in frustration, “Brother Zhou, of all people, you should understand this sentiment.”

Great Zhou King grunted as his characters continued attacking, sending numerous shockwaves rippling out. Junior Zhou King also manifested a character. The incredibly powerful character exploded as it met Great Han King’s fist. The massive explosion caused even the River of Time to shake. Seeing that, a myriad race Invincible bellowed, “Help him! Stabilize the river!”

At that, multiple Invincibles reached out to stabilize the river. Further away, Liu Wushen continued rushing over even as multicolored rays of light continued shining from his body. As he flew over, he roared and cried madly.
Human Realm.
Nanyuan.
Zhang Qi, the future body of Great Han King, frowned. Instead of resuming his attacks, he walked toward the River of Time as he coldly said, “Nobody can stop me!”
With that, he dove into the river.
Inside the ruin, Su Yu was also raging. How could it be…Great Han King?
Impossible!
He had even learned the strength character from Great Han King. He was finding it hard to accept that Great Han King was the traitor.
He wasn’t surprised that there was a second traitor since the wrist of the first traitor did not seem to have any symbols. But he had never expected Great Han King to be the second traitor.
Under his lead, Great Han was also one of the strongest prefectures of humanity.
That was also a valiant prefecture. How could the Invincible of such a prefecture be a traitor?
How was that possible?

Several Invincibles were trying to summon their main bodies over, including the Yellow Department head. Noticing the interference to his attempt, the department head shouted, “Little Brother, affirm your dao! Now!”
Zhu Tiandao gnashed his teeth and said, “Fine. I’ll do it right in the Human Realm. Don’t blame me for draining Great Xia of its source qi.”

Then, the Hundred Dao Pagoda reappeared with his future body. The River of Time appeared beside him as a second Zhu Tiandao walked out. The immortal king, who was Zhu Tiandao’s opponent, was also busy summoning his own bodies over. Thus, Zhu Tiandao was free to affirm his dao without any interference.

Meanwhile, numerous Invincibles of both sides converged near Great Han King. In the boundless void, more than ten Invincibles were attacking Great Ming King, but they were only keeping the human Invincibles occupied instead of fighting with their lives on the line.
There was no need to risk their lives. Just keeping these human Invincibles occupied would be enough to achieve their goal.
If Zhu Tianfang was prevented from assembling his main body, he wouldn’t be able to handle the other myriad race Invincibles in the Human Realm after they were done assembling their main bodies.
With a roar, First Profound started his dao affirmation as well. The First Divine Sect master did the same. One after another, they began their dao affirmation.

Meanwhile, the myriad race Pseudo Invincibles were left feeling quite helpless. Firstly, they needed carrier treasures if they wanted to affirm their dao as well. Secondly, this was the Human Realm. Were they supposed to affirm their dao in the Human Realm?
Was that a joke?
They might as well kill themselves.
In the ruin, Su Yu was feeling more and more furious. And the more furious he was, the faster the flow of death qi into his body became.

It was time to kill all these people. He saw no point in dragging this further. He wanted to kill them all before asking for the stone statue’s help in the Allheaven Battlefield. His patience was running dangerously thin.

With a furious punch, he blasted Soulcurse of the celestial chasm race apart. But that wasn’t enough to kill Soulcurse. Thankfully, the little furball was around to swallow Soulcurse’s sea of willpower to seal Soulcurse’s fate.

The little furball had almost fully digested the Sunmoon character he had eaten earlier. In fact, he seemed to have advanced into the Mountainsea Realm as some heavenly source qi was descending from the sky upon him. However, Su Yu did not pay it much heed since the ruin was already filled with heavenly source qi in the first place.
But suddenly, a loud rumble rang out. Something seemed to have exploded.
“Su Yu!”
A mournful wail rang out as the ninth-stage Sunmoon who was Soulcurse’s dao protector started rushing toward Su Yu madly. Prior to this, he was in the middle of a battle with Qin Hao.
Soulcurse had been killed.
Ranked eighteenth on the Heaven Index, he had been killed.

This was the only Heaven Index genius to have died in this incident. But Su Yu didn’t even spare his latest feat much thought. He was still raging at Great Han King’s betrayal. Like many others, he found that unacceptable.
How could that be?
That was a founding king, the protector of millions upon millions of human lives. How could he?
More and more death qi leaked out of Su Yu’s body.
Suddenly, the mayor’s medallion in his sea of willpower shook slightly as a voice rang out, “Keep yourself under control. Your death qi is getting too thick.”
Su Yu was greatly surprised. What?
A message from the stone statue?
Was the stone statue so impressive that he could actually send a voice transmission across realms?
And the stone statue was even capable of monitoring his current state?
In the sky.

The stone statue was looking around. He was in a way a big lump of stone. If he remained still, nobody would notice him. He could also be considered a living dead. As long as he remained inactive, even Pseudo Emperors would not be able to notice him so easily.

His gaze seemed capable of penetrating the realms as he observed the battle around Great Han King, the battle around Great Ming King, the battle around Wan Tiansheng, who was rapidly recovering, and the various humans attempting to affirm their dao.
As he looked at all the ongoing events, something felt off.

Liu Wushen was the first to succeed in his dao affirmation. The entire process was surprisingly easy. Instead of trying to kill him, two myriad race Invincibles were keeping him occupied while pulling their punches to avoid harming him. They certainly didn’t want to stop Great Han King from returning to the Human Realm.
Elsewhere, the other humans were also madly affirming their dao.
Some were attacked, some were left alone, and some were near completion.
“How odd…”
Something did not feel right to the stone statue. His gaze landed on Great Han King who was battling the two Zhou Kings in the River of Time as his three bodies were finally brought together again.

His gaze then landed on Wan Tiansheng, the Sunmoon who had killed two Invincibles. Why did Great Han King leave a weakened Wan Tiansheng behind instead of killing him? Wasn’t that a dangerous person to leave alive? Why did Great Han King give Wan Tiansheng the time to recover?

At least twenty human Invincibles had gathered around Great Han King. The myriad races had about forty Invincibles there. They were battling around the River of Time, with the humans attempting to cut the connection to the Human Realm while the myriad races were trying to protect the connection.
Naturally, destroying was easier than protecting something. Even with forty Invincibles on their side, the myriad races were still having a hard time keeping the connection stable.
